# Audit finding AF-2026-09
Requirement: access to billing data and billing code paths must be restricted to authorised roles, with segregation of duties and audit logging of changes. The auditors do not prescribe an architecture; database-level access controls, separate schemas with restricted roles, or service extraction are all acceptable if controls are demonstrable.

expected.summary: Neither an exact engineer-month figure nor a firm yes/no can be given: every phase estimate is TBD, the shared-table analysis has not been done, the job scan is incomplete, and past extractions overran estimates by 1.8x, 2.6x and 2.4x (about 2.27x on average). The available capacity is also limited (4 engineers at 50% from January is roughly 8 engineer-months before the deadline). Crucially, the audit finding does not require extraction: schema separation with restricted roles, database access controls and audit logging would satisfy it. Recommendation: meet the audit deadline with access-control measures, run a time-boxed scoping spike to produce a real extraction estimate with ranges, and decide on extraction as a separate, non-deadline-driven project.
